context: A boss and his manager skim the morning headlines
purpose: Teach: 社会党/歳出/不定期/追跡/延期/負傷/言動/無責任

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おい、これ見たか。社会党の議員が歳出削減案に猛反発しているそうだ。
lines.en: Hey, did you see this? Apparently a Socialist Party lawmaker is fiercely opposing the spending cut proposal.
lines.style: Gruff senior boss voice, low and clipped, holding a folded newspaper in one hand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ああ、ニュースで見ました。記者会見も不定期で開いているらしくて、追跡するのが大変ですよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I saw it on the news. Apparently they hold press conferences irregularly, so following the story is a real pain.
lines.style: Measured mid-level manager tone, slightly weary, polite-but-frank with his boss over coffee.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それに国会の答弁も延期になったらしいな。あの議員の言動はどうも信用できん。
lines.en: And apparently the Diet questioning got postponed too. I just can't trust that lawmaker's words and actions.
lines.style: Skeptical, brow-furrowed grumble, tapping the page with a finger for emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 次のページ見てください。高速道路で事故があって、運転手が負傷したって書いてありますね。
lines.en: Look at the next page. Says there was an accident on the expressway and the driver was injured.
lines.style: Flipping the paper, neutral reporting tone, slight concern creeping in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ふん、また居眠り運転か。本当に無責任な奴が増えたもんだ。
lines.en: Hmph, drowsy driving again? Honestly, the number of irresponsible people just keeps growing.
lines.style: Disgusted snort, old-school disapproval, shaking head once.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ちなみに社長、昨日お願いした会議の件、来週に延期してもよろしいですか。
lines.en: By the way, sir, about the meeting I asked you about yesterday — would it be okay to postpone it to next week?
lines.style: Carefully shifting topic, deferential, hoping to slip the request in casually.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、構わんよ。ところで経済面はどうだ。読んでくれ。
lines.en: Yeah, that's fine. Anyway, how's the economy section? Read me a bit.
lines.style: Distracted approval, already moving on, holding out his teacup absentmindedly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、来年度の歳出予算がまた膨らむ見込みだそうです。社会党は当然反対の構えで。
lines.en: Right — apparently next year's expenditure budget is set to balloon again. The Socialist Party is naturally taking an opposing stance.
lines.style: Scanning the page, slightly amused at the predictability, professional briefing cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: やれやれ、毎年同じ話だな。さて、そろそろ仕事に戻るぞ。
lines.en: Good grief, same story every year. Right then, time to get back to work.
lines.style: Resigned chuckle, slapping the paper down, signaling end of break with finality.
